from collections import Counter
source = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Shift the grid down by one row, filling the new row with the background."""
    if not grid:
        return []
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[background for _ in row] for row in grid[:1]] + [list(row) for row in grid[:-1]]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_c613ad6b', program_path)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
print('demo reproduction:', module.transform(demo_in) == demo_out)
print('demo transformed:', module.transform(demo_in))
print('test output:', module.transform(test))
